name: Hasbro
description: Hasbro makes money from two very different businesses. Wizards of the Coast (Magic: The Gathering, Dungeons & Dragons, digital games and licences) is 47 percent of FY2025 revenue and made $1.0 billion of segment profit at a 46 percent margin; Consumer Products (toys and board games such as Monopoly, Play-Doh, Transformers, Nerf and Peppa Pig) is 52 percent of revenue and lost $943 million after a $1.02 billion goodwill write-down tied to tariffs. Revenue was $4.7 billion (+13.7 percent), but operating profit was just $11 million (vs $690 million) because of that write-down. Magic card sales alone added $638 million of growth, driven by Universes Beyond sets (Final Fantasy, Marvel's Spider-Man, Avatar).
